sn35.81:1.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn35.81:1.2: idha no bhante aññatitthiyā paribbājakā amhe evaṃ pucchanti
sn35.81:1.3: kimatthiyaṃ āvuso samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti
sn35.81:1.4: evaṃ puṭṭhā mayaṃ bhante tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākaroma
sn35.81:1.5: dukkhassa kho āvuso pariññatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti
sn35.81:1.6: kacci mayaṃ bhante evaṃ puṭṭhā evaṃ byākaramānā vuttavādino ceva bhagavato homa na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāma dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaroma na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṭṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti.
sn35.81:2.1: taggha tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ puṭṭhā evaṃ byākaramānā vuttavādino ceva me hotha na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhatha dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākarotha na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṭṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
sn35.81:2.2: dukkhassa hi bhikkhave pariññatthaṃ mayi brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
sn35.81:2.3: sace pana vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ
sn35.81:2.4: katamañca pana taṃ āvuso dukkhaṃ yassa pariññāya samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti
sn35.81:2.5: evaṃ paṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha
sn35.81:2.6: cakkhuṃ kho āvuso dukkhaṃ tassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
sn35.81:2.8: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ
sn35.81:2.11: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ
sn35.81:2.13: idaṃ kho taṃ āvuso dukkhaṃ tassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
sn35.81:2.14: evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyāthāti.
